body: Rewrite compilePlanToWorkflow in lib/workflow-emit.mjs to emit an async Python 3 script supporting Antigravity /run-workflow (await parallel(wave, ...), await agent(prompt=..., schema=TICKET_RESULT_SCHEMA, role=..., type_name='self', workspace='inherit', model=...)), per-ticket .worktrees/agb-<ticket-id> provisioning + agb gate-ticket gating when live primitives are present, and clean standalone python3 dry-run JSON output. Enforce AGB_WORKTREE_ROOT physical containment in hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs (buildContext, file mutations, and shell/command write checks): fail closed if AGB_WORKTREE_ROOT is non-empty and non-absolute, and deny any repo/filesystem mutation outside AGB_WORKTREE_ROOT (other than tmpRoots and verified Brain artifacts). Expand test/workflow-emit.test.mjs and test/pre-tool-use.test.mjs.

edges.reason: lib/plan.mjs statically imports compilePlanToWorkflow from lib/workflow-emit.mjs

title: Async /run-workflow Compiler & AGB_WORKTREE_ROOT PreToolUse Confinement
